name: 01/21/2025 Emergency Item 7B for City Council Meeting Agenda of 01/21/2025
agenda_text:
Emergency Item 7B for City Council Meeting Agenda of 01/21/2025

A. RESOLUTION NO. 25-05 RATIFYING THE PROCLAMATION OF THE DIRECTOR
  OF EMERGENCY SERVICES CONCERNING THE EXISTENCE OF A LOCAL
  EMERGENCY FOR THE JANUARY 2025 WIND AND FIRE EVENT

  On January 7, 2025 and in the days following, the City of San Gabriel has been
  impacted by a destructive wind and fire event. The Fire Chief activated the San
  Gabriel Emergency Operations Center (EOC) on January 7 with Public Works, Police,
  Fire and Administrative duties coordinated from the EOC for the next two days. The
  EOC remains open at a stand-by level. Sustained high winds, including gusts of 80
  – 100 miles per hour in some areas, and a conflagration of wildland fire caused
  catastrophic damage to the immediate area and City of San Gabriel. Infrastructure
  damage, fallen trees, smoke, fallout from fire ash and power outages have
  necessitated extensive emergency response and clean up across the City. Staff
  recommends ratification of the proclamation of a local emergency by the City
  Manager pursuant to Title III, Chapter 36, articles 36.05 and 36.06, with the
  adoption of Resolution No. 25-05.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 25-05 ratifying the
  proclamation of the Director of Emergency Services concerning the existence of a
  local emergency.
